# Test cases for module_patterns.txt, executed by the self-check and by CI.
# Snippets are scanned as the printable strings pulled out of a .dll, one per
# line, so they read like strings and not like code. Same format as
# lua_patterns.test.txt.
#
# The negatives are what really does sit in the string table of an ordinary
# Garry's Mod binary module: Lua symbol names, compiler and library banners,
# build paths and the homepage of whatever it links against.
